description_en: Checks whether a server can be restarted when a vulnerability fix requires a restart to take effect
description_zh: 漏洞修复需要重启生效时判断机器当前是否能够重启
name: DescribeMachineCanReboot

parameters.help_en:
The type of vulnerability that requires a restart to fix. Valid values:
cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
需要重启修复的漏洞类型。取值：
cve linux系统漏洞
sys windows系统漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the server to restart
parameters.name: uuid
